initialPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 3D game material texture atlas for a Minecraft Java mod recreating Clash Royale troops. Generate a perfectly aligned 4 by 4 grid of square material swatches, exactly 1024x1024 pixels, each swatch exactly 256x256 with no margins, no gaps, no dividers, no words. This is a flat albedo texture sheet, NOT a model preview. Hand-painted premium stylized game materials, readable restrained detail, rich middle colors, flat even illumination, no baked directional light. Row1 left to right: (1) warm peach tan skin with subtle soft color variation no body parts (2) bright golden yellow hair strands (3) warm dark brown leather with fine pores (4) weathered cool blue-gray steel with delicate scratches. Row2: (5) deep royal cobalt blue cloth weave (6) aged ivory bone surface (7) charcoal black near-solid shadow material (8) dark rocky grey craggy granite with broad angular fissures, Golem stone. Row3: (9) glowing pink magenta purple crystal facets, clear saturated (10) midnight indigo violet hood cloth (11) desaturated pale blue gray skin surface (12) dark purple bat wing membrane with subtle veins. Row4: (13) rough golden oak timber grain vertical (14) golden straw thatch laid vertically (15) aged rich golden brass (16) off-white eye sclera / teeth material. Each material fills entire own tile exactly edge to edge, tile boundaries precisely at x and y 256,512,768. No faces, no silhouettes, no characters, no lighting shadows around tiles, no gradients across atlas. Intended applied directly to articulated cuboid models.
finalEditPrompt: Edit this 4x4 production material atlas. Keep every tile in the EXACT same grid position and same base color/material: tan skin, yellow hair, brown leather, steel / cobalt cloth, ivory bone, black, gray golem stone / purple crystal, deep violet cloth, blue-gray skin, purple bat wing / golden wood, straw, gold, cream white. Make it much cleaner and more stylized for low-poly Minecraft Clash Royale models. Remove ALL photographic noise, grain, fine scratches and tiny woven details. Each tile should read as a smooth clear material with just 3-5 broad painted tones, not speckled. Skin, leather, cloth, bone, metal should be mostly uniform color, subtle shading, maximum 4-6 very broad strokes per tile. Rock: light medium gray base (noticeably LIGHTER than existing), only 3-4 large broad soft facets with subtle cracks, NO dense mosaic of pebbles. Hair and wood and straw: only 6-8 broad parallel strokes per tile, no thin strands. Crystal: 4-6 broad pinkish-purple facets. Eyes tile bottom right almost solid warm white. Exact square equal 4x4 tiles, no margins, no text, no labels, no borders, no characters. Pure flat albedo texture sheet, not a preview.
